ticket.title: The poller/reconcile blob writers also erase threadToken — on the CONFIRM/heal path, not just the failure path #936 fixes
ticket.description:
# KS-1074 — Wednesday's task for Ornith, PART C of three (written 22:34 on 2026-09-15 from the file at develop M55 `48e65c435`: `services/originate/src/services/anchorStateSync.ts` lines 45, 138–190, 200–280 read whole; `repositories/documentRepo.ts:85-92` read; the reference test `ks587-document-blob-simulated.test.ts` read whole) — **JEST service** — PART C = the POLLER's SIMULATED writer only (Part B = the two reconcile writers and Part A = the poller's CONFIRM writer are already done — NOT this task)

## What is wrong (one paragraph)
`updateDocument` REPLACES the `blockchain` blob wholesale (`repositories/documentRepo.ts:480`, a shallow top-level spread — KS-1058), so a writer that builds a fresh `blockchain: {...}` literal destroys every key it does not restate. `pollAnchorUntilConfirmed`'s SIMULATED writer (`anchorStateSync.ts:263-274`, inside `if (simFields.simulated) {` at :262 — the KS-587 declared-simulated branch) writes `{ txHash: null, blockHeight, anchoredAt, network, status, anchorId, ...simFields }` — no `threadToken` — so a document that mints a thread token at create and whose anchor is SIMULATED loses its `threadToken` cache the moment the poller declares the simulation. Unlike the reconcile writers, the poller has NO prior blob in scope (it receives only ids), so the fix follows the precedent of the already-fixed failure writer `markDocumentAnchorFailed` (:152-157): READ the document with `getDocument(documentId, tenantId)` (already imported at line 45) immediately before the write, and carry `threadToken` EXPLICITLY — never by spreading the prior blob (KS-1058's cells forbid carrying `confidence` / `anchoredAt`). Wednesday's decision, recorded for the PR seat: one `getDocument` read per simulated-write (at most one per poll attempt that has a hash — ≤ 60 reads over a 10-minute poll), because a read taken once before the loop would race the create-time mint. Nothing else in the file changes.

## The exact change — TWO edits inside the SIMULATED writer, each its own hunk with 3 lines of context
E1 — INSERT one line immediately AFTER line 262 (context: line 261 is `      const simFields = simulatedFieldsFromAnchor(anchor);`, line 262 is `      if (simFields.simulated) {`, line 263 is `        await updateDocument(documentId, tenantId, {`). No line is removed:
```
       const simFields = simulatedFieldsFromAnchor(anchor);
       if (simFields.simulated) {
+        const prior = (await getDocument(documentId, tenantId))?.blockchain;
         await updateDocument(documentId, tenantId, {
           blockchain: {
```
E2 — INSERT one line immediately AFTER line 270 (context: line 269 is `            status: confirmed ? 'confirmed' : (anchor.status || 'submitted'),`, line 270 is `            anchorId,` — the shorthand property inside the SIMULATED writer's blob; line 271 is `            ...simFields,`). No line is removed; the new line goes BEFORE `...simFields,`:
```
             status: confirmed ? 'confirmed' : (anchor.status || 'submitted'),
             anchorId,
+            ...(prior?.threadToken ? { threadToken: prior.threadToken } : {}),
             ...simFields,
           },
```
Both edits sit between lines 262 and 274. Do NOT touch the CONFIRM writer at 228–238 (its own `            anchorId,` is at line 235 — Part A, already done — leave it), `markDocumentAnchorFailed`, the reconcile writers (already carry the token), or any `logger.info` line. `prior` is block-scoped inside `if (simFields.simulated) {` and the name is free there (Part A's `prior` lives in a different block).

## THIS IS JEST, NOT VITEST
`repo.test_runner` begins with `jest`: `jest.mock(...)` (auto-hoisted), `jest.fn()`, globals `describe/it/expect/beforeEach/afterAll`. No `vi.*`, no `import ... from 'vitest'`. ts-jest TYPE-CHECKS the file (`noUnusedLocals`): declare only what you use.

## The test — one new jest file, the ks587 poller driver copied VERBATIM
File: `services/originate/src/__tests__/ks1074-poller-simulated-writer-preserves-thread-token.test.ts`
Copy from `services/originate/src/__tests__/ks587-document-blob-simulated.test.ts` EXACTLY these file-scope declarations, in this order: `const mockGetDocument = jest.fn();`, `const mockUpdateDocument = jest.fn();`, the `jest.mock('../repositories/documentRepo', ...)` block (lines 36–39), the `jest.mock('../utils/logger', ...)` block (lines 41–43), then ONLY this import from anchorStateSync: `import { pollAnchorUntilConfirmed } from '../services/anchorStateSync';` (do NOT copy the `import { … } from '../services/…'` block at lines 45–50 and do NOT import `reconcileDocumentAnchorState` — unused imports fail ts-jest), `import type { DocumentRecord } from '../repositories/documentRepo';`, `const REAL_TX = '4f1e6a8d2c7b9e3f1a5b7c9d2e4f6a8b1c3d5e7f9a2b4c6d8e0f2a4b6c8d0e2f';`, the `baseDoc(overrides)` function (lines 57–71), the `anchorResponse(body, ok = true)` function (lines 73–76), `const realFetch = global.fetch;`, `let mockFetch: jest.Mock;`, the `beforeEach` (lines 94–99) and the `afterAll` (lines 101–103). ALSO copy `const MOCK_TX = `mock_tx_${'a'.repeat(64)}`;` (line 55) and the `simulatedAnchorRead(over)` function (lines 78–89) — both are used below. Add ONE file-scope constant after `REAL_TX`:
```
const THREAD_TOKEN = { policyId: 'b'.repeat(56), scriptAddress: 'addr_test1wq_ks1074', mintTxHash: 'c'.repeat(64), network: 'preview' };
```
Helper (file scope): `function docWithToken(): DocumentRecord { return baseDoc({ blockchain: { txHash: null, blockHeight: 0, status: 'pending', anchorId: 'anchor_1', threadToken: THREAD_TOKEN } } as Partial<DocumentRecord>); }`
Every cell: `mockFetch.mockResolvedValue(anchorResponse(simulatedAnchorRead()));` (a CONFIRMED simulated anchor: `transactionHash: null`, `simulated: true`, `simulatedTxRef: MOCK_TX`) then `await pollAnchorUntilConfirmed({ anchorId: 'anchor_1', documentId: 'doc-ks1074', tenantId: 'tenant-1', authHeader: 'Bearer t', intervalMs: 1, maxAttempts: 10 });` then `expect(mockUpdateDocument).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1); const blob = (mockUpdateDocument.mock.calls[0][2] as any).blockchain;`
Cells (every cell 🔴 or CONTROL, nothing optional), inside `describe('KS-1074 — the poller simulated writer preserves threadToken', () => { ... })`:
- 🔴 `it('🔴 KS-1074 — a declared-simulated anchor keeps the prior threadToken on the document blob')`: `mockGetDocument.mockResolvedValue(docWithToken());` … `expect(blob.simulated).toBe(true); expect(blob.txHash).toBeNull(); expect(blob.threadToken).toEqual(THREAD_TOKEN);` (Untouched code: the write has no `threadToken` key — the red.)
- 🔴 `it('🔴 KS-1074 — the writer READS the document before it writes')`: `mockGetDocument.mockResolvedValue(docWithToken());` … `expect(mockGetDocument).toHaveBeenCalledWith('doc-ks1074', 'tenant-1');` (Untouched code: the SIMULATED branch never calls `getDocument` — `toHaveBeenCalledWith` fails by assertion — the red.)
- CONTROL `it('KS-1074 control — with no threadToken in the prior blob the write carries no threadToken key')`: `mockGetDocument.mockResolvedValue(baseDoc());` … `expect(blob.simulated).toBe(true); expect('threadToken' in blob).toBe(false);` — green on both trees (the carry is conditional).
- CONTROL `it('KS-1074 control — the simulated write still carries its declaration and the KS-521 option')`: `mockGetDocument.mockResolvedValue(docWithToken());` … `expect(blob.simulatedTxRef).toBe(MOCK_TX); expect(blob.status).toBe('confirmed'); expect(blob.anchorId).toBe('anchor_1'); expect(mockUpdateDocument.mock.calls[0][4]).toEqual({ preserveTerminalStatuses: true });` — green on both trees.

## Where (parsed into the checklist — every **must change** line must appear as a `-` line in your diff)
* `:262` — (correct) `      if (simFields.simulated) {` — the ANCHOR for E1: the `const prior` read is inserted immediately after it (no line is removed; an insert-only edit has NO must-change line)
* `:270` — (correct) `            anchorId,` — the ANCHOR for E2 (the SIMULATED writer's blob): the carry line is inserted immediately after it, before `            ...simFields,` (no line is removed)
* `:235` — (correct) `            anchorId,` — the CONFIRM writer's blob; stays — do NOT touch (Part A)
* `:45` — (correct) `import { getDocument, updateDocument, DocumentRecord } from '../repositories/documentRepo';` — `getDocument` is already imported; stays
* `:182` — (correct) `      ...(prior?.threadToken ? { threadToken: prior.threadToken } : {}),` — KS-1058's carry in the failure writer; the shape to copy; stays
